title: The Buyer’s Lens: 4 Factors That Drive a Deal Across the Finish Line
summary: Laca Wong-Hammond shares what M&A buyers want in a target: predictable financials, sound operations, continuity, and clear paths to growth.
body_markdown:
[Laca Wong-Hammond](https://www.lument.com/mergers-acquisitions/laca-wong-hammond/) , Head of Mergers & Acquisitions at Lument, outlines four qualities buyers look for in a target company: predictable financials, sound operational infrastructure, continuity of operations, and clear avenues for growth.


From vetted financials and strong operational controls to staff retention and growth potential, Laca shares what buyers look for in a deal.


###### Buyers and sellers alike can benefit from the options Lument’s M&A team provides.
